subject: Admin Codex Embed route returning 404 — Autonomys upload panel inaccessible
content:
The SmartTriad Codex Manager page at /admin/smarttriad/codex is failing to load. The embedded iframe points to https://dev-beta.aigentz.me/triad/embed/admin/codex and is returning HTTP 404.

Health check results (2026-04-08T08:44:01Z):
- Wallet Embed (/triad/embed/wallet) → 200 OK ✅
- Codex Embed (/triad/embed/codex) → 200 OK ✅
- Admin Codex Embed (/triad/embed/admin/codex) → 404 Not Found ❌

The CSP headers on the 404 response still include frame-ancestors for lovable.app, so the route existed at some point but the page/handler is missing.

Questions for WS/AigentiQ team:
1. Was /triad/embed/admin/codex renamed or moved to a different path?
2. Is there a deployment issue where the admin codex route was not included in the latest build?
3. What is the correct URL for the Autonomys/Auto Drive content upload and codex management panel?

This is blocking all admin codex operations including Autonomys uploads, episode management, and cover management.

Also outstanding from previous message (lovable-qripto-loop-price-20260407):
- Confirm exact Supabase field name for loop video toggle: is it 'loop' or 'loop_video' in modalities.watch?
- Add Q¢ price field to admin content editor writing to pricing_model.tiers[0].amount
